overview.en: Nomura jellyfish is a large scyphozoan in the family Rhizostomatidae.
overview.fr: La méduse de Nomura est un grand scyphozoaire de la famille des Rhizostomatidae.

identification.en: It can reach about 2 metres in bell diameter and 200 kilograms in wet mass, although such maxima are exceptional.
identification.fr: Elle peut atteindre environ 2 mètres de diamètre de cloche et 200 kilogrammes de masse humide, même si ces maxima sont exceptionnels.

habitat.en: Its range includes the Bohai, Yellow, East China and Japan seas; currents can carry medusae from spawning areas toward Japan and Korea.
habitat.fr: Son aire comprend les mers de Bohai, Jaune, de Chine orientale et du Japon ; les courants peuvent transporter les méduses depuis leurs zones de ponte vers le Japon et la Corée.

diet.en: Korean fisheries information reports that it consumes zooplankton and fish eggs, but the relative importance of these foods is not quantified there.
diet.fr: Les informations halieutiques coréennes indiquent qu’elle consomme du zooplancton et des œufs de poissons, sans quantifier l’importance relative de ces aliments.

behavior.en: At one Japan Sea study site, most observed medusae stayed above roughly 40 metres during daytime; this result is local, not a universal depth limit.
behavior.fr: Sur un site étudié en mer du Japon, la plupart des méduses observées restaient au-dessus d’environ 40 mètres durant la journée ; ce résultat local ne constitue pas une limite de profondeur générale.

reproduction.en: Benthic polyps release young medusae seasonally, with April–June release reported in the Yellow and East China seas.
reproduction.fr: Les polypes benthiques libèrent des jeunes méduses de façon saisonnière ; cette libération est rapportée d’avril à juin dans les mers Jaune et de Chine orientale.

ecology.en: Its mass appearances are irregular, and drifting blooms can obstruct fishing gear and damage fisheries across East Asia.
ecology.fr: Ses apparitions massives sont irrégulières, et les essaims dérivants peuvent obstruer les engins de pêche et nuire aux pêcheries d’Asie orientale.

conservation.en: The Korean national marine species list does not mark it as a marine protected species; this says nothing about its status in other countries.
conservation.fr: La liste marine nationale coréenne ne la désigne pas comme espèce marine protégée ; cela ne renseigne pas sur son statut dans les autres pays.

title.en: Blooms of the giant jellyfish Nemopilema nomurai — Plankton and Benthos Research
title.fr: Essaims de la méduse géante Nemopilema nomurai — Plankton and Benthos Research

facts: The review gives the species' East Asian marginal-sea range, maximum bell diameter of about 2 m and wet mass of about 200 kg, polyp release from April to June in the Yellow and East China seas, current-driven dispersal, and impacts of blooms on fisheries.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.fr: Système d’information biologique pour la vie marine — JAMSTEC

facts: The Japanese marine-life database gives the accepted name Nemopilema nomurai, Japanese name Echizen kurage, and taxonomic placement in Rhizostomatidae.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Nomura jellyfish — Korean National Institute of Fisheries Science
title.fr: Méduse de Nomura — Institut national coréen des sciences halieutiques

facts: The Korean species account notes occurrence in the country's east, west and south seas, describes a seasonal appearance from May into early winter, reports zooplankton and fish eggs as food, and discusses interference with fisheries.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Vertical distribution survey of the giant jellyfish Nemopilema nomurai — Japanese Society of Fisheries Science
title.fr: Étude de la répartition verticale de la méduse géante Nemopilema nomurai — Société japonaise des sciences halieutiques

facts: A daytime survey about 100 km off the Noto Peninsula found almost all observed animals shallower than approximately 40 m at that site.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Bloom frequency and distribution vary by year; proposed environmental drivers are not established as a single cause. The shallow daytime observation is site-specific, and maximum body size should not be read as typical size.
review_note: Cross-checked English-language fisheries research with Japanese JAMSTEC and fisheries-journal records and the Korean National Institute of Fisheries Science account. Kept the local depth observation and upper body-size values qualified.
